Three ways Codility connects
Hiring: from your ATS and back
Send assessments from candidate records in 18 supported applicant tracking systems. Scores and report links return to the same record. Supported systems also create interview links.
Screen for engineering
Skills Intelligence: from your HR system
Skills Intelligence imports people, teams and roles to organize engineering and business role assessments. Our connector covers more than 80 HR systems, including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, ADP, Personio and BambooHR. Confirm support with our team.

Before you connect
Your applicant tracking system sends the candidate details Codility needs, such as name and email, and the assessment chosen for the role. Codility returns assessment status, scores and report links. Some integrations also return task details and integrity signals. Each integration page lists what it supports.
Yes, where the applicant tracking system supports stage triggers. Your team chooses the stage. Setup differs by system and is described in each setup guide.
